AddObject.description: Adds an object (image, shape or chart) to the current slide layout.

params.description: The object which will be added to the current slide layout.
params.name: oDrawing

returns.description: returns false if slide layout doesn't exist.
return false if slide layout doesn't exist.

Copy.description:
Creates a copy of the specified slide layout object.

Copies without master slide.

returns.description: returns new ApiLayout object that represents the copy of slide layout. Returns null if slide layout doesn't exist.

Delete.description: Deletes the specified object from the parent slide master if it exists.

returns.description: return false if parent slide master doesn't exist.

Duplicate.description: Creates a duplicate of the specified slide layout object, adds the new slide layout to the slide layout collection.

params.description: Position where the new slide layout will be added.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns new ApiLayout object that represents the copy of slide layout. Returns null if slide layout doesn't exist or is not in the slide master.

FollowMasterBackground.description: Sets the master background as the background of the layout.

returns.description: returns false if master is null or master hasn't background.

GetAllCharts.description: Returns an array with all the chart objects from the slide layout.

GetAllDrawings.description: Returns an array with all the drawing objects from the slide layout.

GetAllImages.description: Returns an array with all the image objects from the slide layout.

GetAllOleObjects.description: Returns an array with all the OLE objects from the slide layout.

GetAllShapes.description: Returns an array with all the shape objects from the slide layout.

GetAllTables.description: Returns an array with all tables from the current slide layout.

returns.description: An array with all tables from the current slide layout.

GetBackground.description: Returns the background fill of the current slide layout.

returns.description: returns null if the slide layout doesn't exist or has no background fill.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiLayout class.

GetDrawingsByPlaceholderType.description: Returns an array of drawings by the specified placeholder type.

GetLayoutType.description: Returns the type of the current layout.

GetMaster.description: Returns the parent slide master of the current layout.

returns.description: returns null if parent slide master doesn't exist.

GetName.description: Returns a name of the current layout.

GetVisitor.description: Returns a visitor object for traversing the drawings and text of the current slide layout.
GetVisitor.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GroupDrawings.description: Groups an array of drawings in the current layout.

params.description: An array of drawings to group.
params.name: aDrawings

MoveTo.description: Moves the specified layout to a specific location within the same collection.

params.description: Position where the specified slide layout will be moved to.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns false if layout or parent slide master doesn't exist or position is invalid.

RemoveObject.description: Removes objects (image, shape or chart) from the current slide layout.

params.description: Position from which the object will be deleted.
params.name: nPos

params.description: The number of elements to delete.
params.name: nCount

returns.description: returns false if layout doesn't exist or position is invalid or layout hasn't objects.

Search.description: Searches for the specified text within the current slide layout and returns all found occurrences as text ranges.

params.description: The text to search for, or a regular expression to match. When a RegExp is passed, isMatchCase and isWholeWords are ignored (control case sensitivity with the "i" flag instead).
params.name: text

params.description: Whether to search for whole words only.
params.name: isWholeWords

Search.signature: Search(text: string | RegExp, isMatchCase?: boolean, isWholeWords?: boolean): ApiTextRange[]

SetBackground.description: Sets the background to the current slide layout.

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the presentation slide layout background.
params.name: oApiFill

SetName.description: Sets a name to the current layout.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiLayout object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the slide master will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteMaster

params.description: Specifies whether to write used table styles to the JSON object (true) or not (false).
params.name: bWriteTableStyles
